stem: A car is moving with a speed of 40 m/s. The driver observes a stationary truck ahead at a distance of 120 m. After a reaction time of δt, the driver applies the brake producing a retardation of 8 m/s<sup>2</sup>. What is the maximum reaction time to avoid collision?

assets.alt: Velocity–time graph in m/s and s: constant at 40 for a reaction time δt (shaded area 40δt), then a straight fall to zero over 40/8 = 5 s (area 100 m). Total area = 120 m.
